questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Raze
questions.solution:
A) Raze (verb) – To completely destroy, demolish, level to the ground.ध्‍वस्‍त करना
Antonym:Build(verb) – To construct, create, assemble, put together. बनाना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Modest
questions.solution:
D) Modest(adjective) – Being unassuming or moderate in the estimation of one's abilities or achievements, humble, unpretentious. विनम्र
Antonym:Conceited(adjective) – Excessively proud of oneself, vain, self-centered, self-admiring. अभिमानी

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Tenacious
questions.solution:
D) Tenacious(adjective) – Holding firmly, persistent, determined, strong-willed. दृढ़
Antonym:Yielding(adjective) – Giving way under pressure, not resistant, acquiescent. समझाया हुआ

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
ROUGH
questions.solution:
C) ROUGH(adjective) – Having an uneven or irregular surface; not smooth or level. रूखा
Antonym:Smooth(adjective) – Having an even and regular surface; free from perceptible projections, lumps, or indentations. चिकना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Camaraderie
questions.solution:
D) Camaraderie(noun) – Mutual trust and friendship among people who spend a lot of time together, companionship, comradeship. सौहार्द, भाई-चारा
Antonym:Dislike(noun) – A feeling of distaste or hostility, aversion, antipathy, enmity. नफ़रत

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Criticise
questions.solution:
D) Criticise(verb) – Indicate the faults of (someone or something) in a disapproving way, find fault with, censure. आलोचना करना
Antonym:Praise(verb) – Express warm approval or admiration of, commend, applaud, eulogize. प्रशंसा करना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Appal
questions.solution:
B)Appal(verb) – To greatly dismay or horrify, shock, disgust. भयभीत
Antonym:Assure(verb) – To inform positively, to give confidence to, comfort. आश्वस्त

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Rely
questions.solution:
B) Rely(verb) – To depend on or trust in someone or something. भरोसा करना
Antonym:Distrust(verb) – To doubt the honesty or reliability of; regard with suspicion. संदेह करना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Prey
questions.solution:
A) Prey(noun) – An animal that is hunted and killed by another for food, victim. शिकार
Antonym:Predator(noun) – An animal that naturally preys on others, hunter. शिकारी

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Optional
questions.solution:
B) Optional(adjective) – Available to be chosen but not obligatory, voluntary, elective. वैकल्पिक
Antonym:Compulsory(adjective) – Required by law or rule, obligatory, mandatory. अनिवार्य

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Linger
questions.solution:
A) Linger(verb) – To stay in a place longer than necessary, delay, dawdle, loiter. देरी करना
Antonym:Leave(verb) – To go away from, depart, exit, go out. छोड़ना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
CLENCH
questions.solution:
D) Clench(verb) – To grip or hold tightly or firmly, to set (something) in a tightly closed position. कसना
Antonym:Relax(verb) – To make less tense or firm, to loosen. आराम करना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Ascent
questions.solution:
A) Ascent(noun) – A climb or walk to the summit of a mountain or hill; an upward movement. चढ़ाई
Antonym:Descent(noun) – An action of moving downward, dropping, or falling; a downward slope. उतार

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Rectify
questions.solution:
A) Rectify(verb) – To make right or correct, to amend, to adjust. सुधारना
Antonym:Corrupt(verb) – To alter from the original or correct form or version, to degrade, to spoil. बिगाड़ना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Negligent
questions.solution:
D) Negligent(adjective) – Failing to take proper care or showing lack of attention, careless, heedless, lax. लापरवाह
Antonym:Careful(adjective) – Taking pain to avoid harm or damage, cautious, attentive, heedful. सतर्क

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
CENTRE
questions.solution:
A) CENTRE(noun) – The middle point of something, midpoint, middle, heart. केंद्र
Antonym:Periphery(noun) – The outer limits or edge of an area or object, boundary, border, fringe. परिधि

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Ransack
questions.solution:
C) Ransack(verb) – To search thoroughly or vigorously, often with the intention of theft or destruction. लूटना
Antonym:Protect(verb) – To keep safe from harm or injury, to shield, to safeguard. सुरक्षित करना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Exonerate
questions.solution:
C) Exonerate(verb) – To absolve someone from blame for a fault or wrongdoing, to clear from accusation or blame. मुक्त करना
Antonym:Engage(verb) – To occupy, attract, or involve (someone's interest or attention), or to cause someone to become involved in (a contract or a duty). संलग्न होना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Obscure
questions.solution:
B) Obscure(adjective) – Not clear or hard to understand; not discovered or known about; uncertain. अस्पष्ट
ANTONYM:Apparent(adjective) – Clearly visible or understood; obvious. स्पष्ट

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
OCCUPIED
questions.solution:
B) Occupied(adjective) – Being used by someone; not available because someone is using it. अधिकृत
Antonym:Free(adjective) – Not being used or occupied; unoccupied, available, at liberty. मुक्त
